baselinePolicy.currentComponent: Mean of the offense's other same-season REG games (leave-one-out); completedGames = that count
baselinePolicy.priorComponent: Mean of the offense's REG games in the previous season

percent.formula: 100 * sum(actual - baseline) / sum(baseline) over the sampled games

metrics.pass: Gross team passing yards (all QB/RB/WR/TE passers; sack yards are not subtracted)
metrics.rush: Team rushing yards from QB/RB/WR/TE rows
